title: Saturated phase densities of (CO2 + H2O) at temperatures from (293 to 450) K and pressures up to 64 MPa (E.C. Efika, R. Hoballah, X. Li, E.F. May, M. Nania, Y. Sanchez-Vicente, J.P.M. Trusler)
needs_pass2_reason: the table bodies are not in the PDF text layer (only captions), so the cells came from tesseract OCR of 300 dpi renders; 91 cells (mostly the one-digit uncertainty column, missing decimal points, plus a few T/rho cells) needed correction after the image check
experimental_method: Equilibrium cell with two syringe pumps and two vibrating tube densimeters in one thermostat; saturated aqueous (bottom) and CO2-rich (top) phases displaced sequentially at constant pressure into the densimeters, calibrated in situ with water, CO2 and helium.
uncertainties_stated: Average standard uncertainties 1.5 kg/m3 (CO2-rich phase) and 1.0 kg/m3 (aqueous phase); u(T) = 0.2 K, u(p) = 0.05 MPa; per-row combined u_c(rho) is tabulated.
quality_remarks: Table 3 row 322.7 K 8.44 MPa 1001.9 followed by 322.8 K 8.55 MPa 1001.3 breaks monotonic rho(p) by 0.6 kg/m3 (as printed, within u_c; also 8.57 -> 1002.0 follows). CO2-rich phase density is for a phase near-saturated at T_sat but measured 1-2 K higher in T_VTD (heated to avoid water condensation). Leaky PTFE seal replaced periodically; authors state all reported data are from leak-free operation. Authors compare with Gernert-Span EOS which under-predicts aqueous density by up to 13 kg/m3.
not_extracted_tables: Compositions of the saturated phases are not measured; the paper calculates them with empirical models (derived, no table).
extraction_notes: Panels stacked left then right. The 3.5 x 5 char OCR was read with tesseract --psm 6 on column crops, and every row was compared to the 150 dpi page image; a sanity script found p monotonic within each isotherm in both tables, rho monotonic with p in Table 3 apart from the one printed reversal noted above. Gas-phase regime flags (lle) for liquid CO2 are inferred from tabulated densities; see mapping. No standard-conditions gas volumes are involved (not applicable).
pass2_diff: Tables 3 and 4: Table 3 580/580 identical; Table 4 had two single-cell disagreements (374.4 vs 374.1, and 1.1 vs 1.0 at 448.5 K) arbitrated with an independent OCR of the page: pass 1 correct on both.
